base: 16:9 landscape scene in Gulmohar Mohalla, a small Indian neighbourhood with narrow lanes, colourful two-storey houses, mud-and-tile homes and big gulmohar trees with flame-orange flowers; summer holidays, warm golden afternoon or evening light. Family-friendly; the children look innocent and age-appropriate. No text, letters, words or numbers anywhere in the image.

scenes.prompt: Inside Dadi's mud house on a hot summer afternoon, warm golden light through a small window: an old wooden trunk is open, clothes folded aside; {golu} kneels and lifts out a yellowed folded paper with both hands, amazed; {tara} and {tinku} lean in from both sides peeking, eyes wide; {mitthu} perches on the trunk's open lid. The paper shows only faint drawn lines, no writing.

Close-up of an old yellowed hand-drawn treasure map held open by {tara}'s hands (only her hands and braids at the edges): drawn only with simple pictures - a big gulmohar tree, a hand pump, two walls side by side with a gap between them, a small X mark and a row of little footprints. Absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers anywhere on the map. Warm afternoon light, paper texture.

In Dadi's sunny aangan: the three children sit together on a charpai reading the old map; {tara} points at it with her pencil, serious and focused; {golu} grins excitedly; {tinku} holds his tummy with a hopeful hungry smile; {mitthu} perches on Golu's shoulder. Golden summer afternoon, gulmohar flowers on the ground. The map shows only pictures, no writing.

Under the big gulmohar tree in the mohalla lane on a golden afternoon: {golu} takes huge exaggerated long steps away from the tree trunk, counting; {tara} and {tinku} count along with their fingers; {mitthu} flies above them. Flame-orange flowers everywhere.

A small vegetable patch with rows of cauliflowers next to a house in the lane: {golu} and {tinku} dig with a small spade and their hands, soil flying, {tara} holds the map; behind them {pandey} in his vest-and-uniform at home bursts out of his gate, shouting angrily, one hand raised. Comic, golden afternoon.

Comic chase in the narrow lane: the three children run away fast towards the camera, {tinku}'s loose striped shirt flapping in the wind, {golu} puffing, {tara} clutching the map; {mitthu} flies ahead of them squawking. A low brick wall runs along the right side of the lane. Bright golden afternoon, dust kicked up.

An old iron hand pump on a small cement platform at a corner of the mohalla, an old brick wall behind it: {tara} walks towards it taking tiny careful steps, looking at the map; {golu} and {tinku} follow behind her. Golden late afternoon light, long shadows.

At the old iron hand pump: {golu} pumps the handle with both hands, water gushing into a puddle; {tinku} stares amazed; {tara} smiles knowingly, listening; {mitthu} perches on top of the hand pump, beak open. Water splashes sparkle in the golden light.

Behind the hand pump: two old brick walls stand close with a narrow dark vertical crack between them; {golu}'s hand is stuck at the opening of the crack and {tara} tries next to him, both straining; {tinku} stands behind them, nervous, as they all slowly turn to look at him. Golden light, mossy bricks.

Close at the narrow crack between the two old brick walls: {tara} shines a small torch into the crack; {tinku}, brave but scared, slides his very thin arm into the crack up to the elbow, eyes squeezed half shut; {golu} watches holding his breath. A tiny glint of something inside the dark gap. Warm afternoon light.

Close-up from above of an old rusty tin box just opened on the ground by the hand pump: inside are colourful glass marbles, a small wooden spinning top, and an old faded black-and-white photo of four small children standing together (tiny, faces soft and unclear). The children's hands and faces around the edges of the frame, amazed. No writing visible anywhere.

Evening in Dadi's aangan in warm golden light: {dadi} sits on the charpai holding the old photo and laughs heartily, hand to her chest; {golu}, {tara} and {tinku} crowd around her, curious and excited; {mitthu} perches on the charpai's edge. The rusty tin box with marbles lies open beside her.

At Dadi's brown wooden door in the evening: {pandey} stands in the doorway holding a dug-up cauliflower in one hand, his angry face melting into an emotional soft look as he stares at the old photo {dadi} shows him; {golu}, {tara} and {tinku} stand open-mouthed in surprise; {mitthu} flaps on the door frame. Warm evening light.

Golden summer evening under the big gulmohar tree: {pandey} happily spins a small wooden top on the ground; {dadi} sits playing marbles; {golu}, {tara} and {tinku} cheer and laugh; {mitthu} flies around happily; behind them the vegetable patch has fresh new cauliflower plants. Keep the group in the LEFT 60% of the image; the right side is the glowing evening sky and the gulmohar tree. Exactly these characters, no other people.
